U-WEDM00.title: DXF/STEP/IGES Parser Pipeline + Geometry Validation
U-WEDM00.description: Select and wire dxf-parser (npm) for DXF R12-R2018 entity parsing (LINE, ARC, CIRCLE, LWPOLYLINE, SPLINE→arc decomposition, ELLIPSE→arc decomposition, INSERT/BLOCK flattening). Wire opencascade.js for STEP AP203/AP214/AP242 and IGES. Create parseGeometryFile() pipeline: raw bytes → entity extraction → BLOCK/INSERT resolution → spline-to-arc conversion (chord tolerance 0.005mm) → gap closure (tolerance 0.01mm) → duplicate entity removal → winding order normalization (CCW=external, CW=internal) → self-intersection detection → PartFeature[] output for EDMDrawingInterpretationEngine. Add geometry validation: closed contour check, min segment length > wire_diameter, min slot width > wire_diameter + 2×spark_gap + 0.05mm. Add error overlay layer to ProfileCanvas layer stack for visual highlighting of geometry issues.

Replace .passthrough() with .strict() on all route-facing Zod schemas. Add concurrent upload semaphore (max 3 simultaneous file operations). Keep express.json limit at 2MB for non-upload routes (NOT 50MB). Add per-route rate limits: RL-EDM-COMPUTE for expensive routes (multipass, toolpath, gcode). Fix duplicate /parameters route. Add missing safety routes (predict-wire-break, calculate-corners, solve-taper).

U-WEDM03.title: Create wedmStudio.ts API client + useWedmPipeline hooks
U-WEDM03.description: Typed API functions for all 18 pipeline endpoints. FormData upload for /interpret. AbortController. Per-step hooks with local loading/error/retry state. Quick Generate uses background job architecture: returns jobId immediately, polls via SSE for progress. Dependency-graph parallelization groups independent calls into Promise.all batches. DAG: interpret -> [selection + feasibility] parallel -> [start-holes + toolpath] parallel -> [tabs + sequence] parallel -> multipass -> optimize -> [flushing + predict-wire-break] parallel -> [corners + taper] parallel -> gcode -> [cost + setup-sheet] parallel. Total chain timeout: 60s (not 90s x 17). Uses existing /api/v1/realtime SSE endpoint for progress events. Define PipelineResponse<T> discriminated union: { ok: true; data: T; warnings: string[] } | { ok: false; error: string; code: string; step: WedmStep }. All WEDM API functions return Promise<PipelineResponse<T>>.

U-WEDM03.exit_gate: Background job returns jobId. SSE emits per-step progress. DAG parallelizes independent calls. Total pipeline completes in <30s for typical jobs. AbortController cancels entire chain.

U-WEDM04.title: Create WedmStudioContext (split navigation + data)
U-WEDM04.description: Two contexts: WedmNavigationContext (currentStep, stepStatuses, setCurrentStep, markStale) and WedmDataContext (per-step result slots, setStepData, clearStep). Implement useSafeSessionStorage hook with quota guard: measure payload size before write, warn at 3.5MB, fall back to IndexedDB when approaching 4MB. Cap per-step data at 256KB. Add sessionId (UUID) and savedAt (ISO8601) to persisted blob for staleness detection. Define IndexedDB schema for sessionStorage fallback: object store 'wedm-sessions' with keyPath 'sessionId', index on 'savedAt'. Schema version 1. Define WedmJobRecord TypeScript interface: { sessionId, jobName, createdAt, updatedAt, schemaVersion: 1, steps: Record<WedmStep, StepData>, material_cert?, program_revision?, quality_events: QualityEvent[] }. All audit trail entries append-only (never mutated after creation).

U-WEDM05.title: Create ProfileCanvas.tsx — 2D Wire EDM profile renderer
